title: Job Interview
statementMd:
Monocarp is opening his own IT company. He wants to hire n𝑛 programmers and m𝑚 testers.

There are n+m+1𝑛+𝑚+1 candidates, numbered from 11 to n+m+1𝑛+𝑚+1 in chronological order of their arriving time. The i𝑖-th candidate has programming skill ai𝑎𝑖 and testing skill bi𝑏𝑖 (a person's programming skill is different from their testing skill). The skill of the team is the sum of the programming skills of all candidates hired as programmers, and the sum of the testing skills of all candidates hired as testers.

When a candidate arrives to interview, Monocarp tries to assign them to the most suitable position for them (if their programming skill is higher, then he hires them as a programmer, otherwise as a tester). If all slots for that position are filled, Monocarp assigns them to the other position.

Your task is, for each candidate, calculate the skill of the team if everyone except them comes to interview. Note that it means that exactly n+m𝑛+𝑚 candidates will arrive, so all n+m𝑛+𝑚 positions in the company will be filled.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer t𝑡 (1≤t≤1041≤𝑡≤104) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of three lines:

- the first line contains two integers n𝑛 and m𝑚 (0≤n,m≤2⋅1050≤𝑛,𝑚≤2⋅105; 2≤n+m+1≤2⋅1052≤𝑛+𝑚+1≤2⋅105) — the number of programmers and the number of testers Monocarp wants to hire, respectively;
- the second line contains n+m+1𝑛+𝑚+1 integers a1,a2,…,an+m+1𝑎1,𝑎2,…,𝑎𝑛+𝑚+1 (1≤ai≤1091≤𝑎𝑖≤109), where ai𝑎𝑖 is the programming skill of the i𝑖-th candidate;
- the third line contains n+m+1𝑛+𝑚+1 integers b1,b2,…,bn+m+1𝑏1,𝑏2,…,𝑏𝑛+𝑚+1 (1≤bi≤1091≤𝑏𝑖≤109; bi≠ai𝑏𝑖≠𝑎𝑖), where bi𝑏𝑖 is the testing skill of the i𝑖-th candidate.

Additional constraint on the input: the sum of (n+m+1)(𝑛+𝑚+1) over all test cases doesn't exceed 2⋅1052⋅105.

## Output

For each test case, print n+m+1𝑛+𝑚+1 integers, where the i𝑖-th integer should be equal to the skill of the team if everyone except the i𝑖-th candidate comes to interview.

## Note

Let's consider the third test case of the example:

- if the 11-st candidate does not arrive, the 22-nd candidate gets hired as a tester, the 33-rd candidate gets hired as a programmer, the 44-th candidate gets hired as a tester. The total skill of the team will be 2+5+1=82+5+1=8;
- if the 22-nd candidate does not arrive, the 11-st candidate gets hired as a tester, the 33-rd candidate gets hired as a programmer, the 44-th candidate gets hired as a tester. The total skill of the team will be 5+5+1=115+5+1=11;
- if the 33-rd candidate does not arrive, the 11-st candidate gets hired as a tester, the 22-nd candidate gets hired as a tester, the 44-th candidate gets hired as a programmer. The total skill of the team will be 5+2+4=115+2+4=11;
- if the 44-th candidate does not arrive, the 11-st candidate gets hired as a tester, the 22-nd candidate gets hired as a tester, the 33-rd candidate gets hired as a programmer. The total skill of the team will be 5+2+5=125+2+5=12.
statementZhMd:
Monocarp 正在创办自己的 IT 公司。他想招聘 $n$ 名程序员和 $m$ 名测试员。

共有 $n+m+1$ 名候选人，他们按照到达时间的先后顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $n+m+1$。第 $i$ 名候选人的编程能力为 $a_i$，测试能力为 $b_i$（一个人的编程能力与测试能力不同）。团队的能力等于所有被聘为程序员的候选人的编程能力之和，加上所有被聘为测试员的候选人的测试能力之和。

当一名候选人到达面试时，Monocarp 会尝试将其分配到最适合他的职位（如果他的编程能力更高，就将其聘为程序员，否则聘为测试员）。如果该职位的所有名额都已满，Monocarp 就会将他分配到另一个职位。

你的任务是：对于每名候选人，计算在除他之外的所有人都参加面试时，团队的能力。注意，这意味着恰好有 $n+m$ 名候选人参加面试，因此公司的全部 $n+m$ 个职位都会被填满。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1\le t\le 10^4$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例包含三行：

- 第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$（$0\le n,m\le 2\cdot 10^5$；$2\le n+m+1\le 2\cdot 10^5$）——Monocarp 分别想招聘的程序员和测试员数量；
- 第二行包含 $n+m+1$ 个整数 $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_{n+m+1}$（$1\le a_i\le 10^9$），其中 $a_i$ 表示第 $i$ 名候选人的编程能力；
- 第三行包含 $n+m+1$ 个整数 $b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_{n+m+1}$（$1\le b_i\le 10^9$；$b_i\ne a_i$），其中 $b_i$ 表示第 $i$ 名候选人的测试能力。

输入的额外约束：所有测试用例中的 $(n+m+1)$ 之和不超过 $2\cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出 $n+m+1$ 个整数，其中第 $i$ 个整数应等于除第 $i$ 名候选人之外的所有人都参加面试时团队的能力。

## 说明

考虑样例中的第三个测试用例：

- 如果第 $1$ 名候选人没有到达，第 $2$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $3$ 名候选人会被聘为程序员，第 $4$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员。团队的总能力为 $2+5+1=8$；
- 如果第 $2$ 名候选人没有到达，第 $1$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $3$ 名候选人会被聘为程序员，第 $4$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员。团队的总能力为 $5+5+1=11$；
- 如果第 $3$ 名候选人没有到达，第 $1$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $2$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $4$ 名候选人会被聘为程序员。团队的总能力为 $5+2+4=11$；
- 如果第 $4$ 名候选人没有到达，第 $1$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $2$ 名候选人会被聘为测试员，第 $3$ 名候选人会被聘为程序员。团队的总能力为 $5+2+5=12$。
